name: Sino Wealth Electronic Ltd.
summary: Sino Wealth Electronic Ltd. designs, processes, manufactures, and sells integrated circuits in China and internationally. The company offers industrial MCU used in smart home appliances, variable frequency motors, and the Internet of Things; battery management chip used in lithium batteries and power battery management; AMOLED display drive chips for smart phones and smart watches; and automotive MCU for electronic control, motors, and batteries. It also provides home appliances; electricity meters; microcontroller; and automotive electronics.
